payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all bus stops after the first, computes time t = (x/vb) + hypot(x-xu, yu)/vs for each, and selects the one minimizing t with tie-breaking on distance.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively evaluates each candidate stop, akin to a branch-and-bound search with a trivial bound (the best so far). Although no branching occurs, branch_and_bound is the closest provided subtype capturing optimization over a finite set.
